notes.title: Devlog 2025-03-21 (Episode 4 - Part 2 is out NOW!)
notes.notes:
Happy Friday, everyone!

It's a great one because today is launch day!

We've been working very hard on this one, and we're sorry it took a bit longer than usual. But I'm happy to say we're in good shape for the next upcoming release.

Some highlights that you can look forward to in the newly released content (minor spoilers ahead):

[list]
[*] If you and Matthias have been making eyes at each other, you can share a very tight, uncomfortable ride in a small elevator. You won't be able to help but 'accidentally' rub up against Matthias and fluster him.
[*] 
[*] If you want to get a little closer to the enigmatic and usually inappropriate Andreas, you can do so while on a chaotic shopping spree for some exotic substances.
[*] 
[*] If you just want to spend some slice-of-life time with Veera and Khalil, you can meet some new friends and pay homage to some loved ones. (You are loved and missed, and now you are forever immortalised little sweetpea.)
[*] 
[*] If you have a thing for the strong Captain types, you'll have the opportunity to make some suggestive comments and take some mildly inappropriate actions.
[*] 
[*] You get to meet some new alien species. Some of them are icky and gross (and yet also sexy, according to feedback? \o/)
[*] 
[*] A new sexual orientation system that allows you to pick who you want to be able to flirt with.
[*] 
[*] A new rival system (very new and not fully fleshed out yet.)
[*] 
[*] A new status message on the main menu will show you how much of all the available content you have experienced. (It's impossible to hit 100% right now due to some seasonal content.)
[*] 
[*] All the regular 'new' stuff: new music, new backgrounds, new characters, new portraits, etc.
[/list]

We also added some niche scenes that most of you will probably never see. The conditions for these to trigger are stringent, but they hit the spot just right if/when you do see them.

Now that this release is done, we'll probably take a break for a day or two and then jump back into things. Our attention will shift to working on and releasing Project Syndicate in May while still working on Infinite Stars on the sidelines:

[list]
[*] Bugfixing and polishing existing content.
[*] 
[*] Adding some more intimate scenes for patrons.
[*] 
[*] Adding some more cutesy ,non-intimate scenes.
[*] 
[*] Expanding on the friendship and rival system.
[*] 
[*] Finalising and adding the new outfit system.
[*] 
[*] Finishing the next (halfway? done) content.
[/list]

Enough of my ramblings. You can find the latest public build on itchio or Steam, and the latest Patreon Build is available [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/124802102]>>>here<<<[/url]

Those of you who have been around for a while know that we love doing cross-promotions during releases, and this release is no different. We have something special thanks to Esh from [url=https://www.patreon.com/c/steamberrystudio/about]Steamberry Studio[/url], the creator of When Stars Collide!

When Stars Collide is a fantastic sci-fi visual novel, (inspired by Star Trek, Firefly and Star Gate) and Esh is an even fantastickler(er?) human. You should definitely check out her project and consider supporting her on Patreon if you like what you see.

Your Mah'Abeu can also roleplay to your heart's content as Ari and Esher from When Stars Collide.

Have a fantastic weekend, be kind to others and stay safe! <3

If you would also like to throw your hat in the ring to beta test for us, [url=https://forms.gle/CGeH5JxDkvJintdF9]please go ahead and fill in the form over here.[/url] (No need to do so again if you've already applied for the priority invite!)

Project Syndicate and Draegan Herald continue to make progress and should be ready for release shortly after the next Infinite Stars release.

This is also the final heads-up about our price increase from the 1st of March. In case this is the first time you've heard of this, Patreon has been nagging us to do a price increase to adjust to inflation (it seems like they care about the sustainability of the project). If you're an existing subscriber, you won't be impacted for at least another month, and Patreon will give you an opportunity to downgrade or cancel your membership, should you wish to do so. If you're a new subscriber (after the 1st of March), the new pricing will take immediate effect for you.
We've taken this opportunity to shake up our reward tiers and benefits.
In a nutshell:
We'll be offering a new citizen/tip jar tier for those of you who wish to continue supporting the development at the current $3 tier.
The ensign tier will change from $3 to $5
The Lieutenant tier will change from $8 to $10
The Commander tier will change from $12 to $15
The remaining tiers won't have their pricing changed, but we have added additional benefits where you can 'commission' new outfits for your favourite crew members while helping us expand and develop the new outfit system. While we experiment with this, the tiers will have limited availability and be on a first-come-first-served principle.
We'll also add an Architect tier with an honorary dev flair and a few other unique benefits.

I hope you all have a fantastic weekend! I'm running late for a special birthday party, so I do need to go, but I hope you're all safe!

In the meantime, Tae has been drawing more portraits from our [url=https://www.patreon.com/infinitestars]newest Captain tier patrons. (They get to add their portrait to the game, either of themselves or their OC, whichever they prefer.)[/url] If you've ever wondered what that process looks like, wonder no more!

The process is really simple. Once a patron signs up to the captain tier, I usually reach out in a few days to get some references. References can be selfies, random photos off the internet, mixing and matching your OC, we've even had references from Sims, like the example below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223954/0255621d5b725602d2d6fee800f54629fa165107.png[/img]

Once we have the reference, Tae takes a day or three to do lineart:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223954/cb7df63fff0c026cc0d0800d13b6ba1b55733486.png[/img]

We then contact the patron, checking if they are happy and if we need to make any changes.

After that, we do the colouring and shading, giving the patron another chance to request any minor changes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223954/b558106af62c150554e971a27303f74834c0ded6.png[/img]

Once that's done, the portrait gets added to the game's next release.

I'm speaking out of turn, but the team is arranging a Halloween themed Infinite Stars fan art competition where the winner wins a portrait commission for Infinite Stars. [url=https://discord.gg/QtAxhP6]The announcement will probably go out on our Discord in a few days.[/url]

notes.title: Devlog 2024-02-23 (Custom Content Workshop)
notes.notes:
Another Friday. Wooo!

I'm a tiny bit sick, but nothing too serious. It's more an annoyance than anything else.

I've been fixing some minor bugs and facial expressions and working on Veera's first intimate scene, which should be in the game next week. I wasn't planning on adding it yet, but inspiration struck, and here we are.

Also, now that I have some more room to breathe, I decided to sacrifice some of my weekend time to host a little workshop on creating your own custom content for Infinite Stars.

If you've ever wanted to dabble in creating your own visual novel, writing fanfiction and seeing it come alive in Infinite Stars as a mod, or just want to flex those creative muscles, you should come join in.

We'll host the workshop on Saturday, the 2nd of March (Not this weekend, but next weekend), and depending on the interest, we'll have two sessions 12 hours apart to give everyone a chance to attend no matter what timezone you are from.

If interested in joining, you should register and also start writing your short story or scene. It doesn't have to be finished, but ideally, you'll have something that we can put into the game on Saturday.

The workshop will be casual and informal, and we will be scripting our scenes together while I give guidance and support to anyone who has questions or runs into any issues.

We'll cover all the basics, like changing backgrounds, having crewmembers appear on the screen, moving them around, changing their outfits and expressions, and anything else you might want to learn to bring your fanfic/mod to life.

We'll keep it simple. Maybe you can't wait any longer to see Raymond and mc smooching, or perhaps you want to write a scene where mc saves the day in Medsec yet again. A leisurely cuddle with your favourite love interest or something silly and fun with Cleo. Write your script, it doesn't have to be perfect, and have it ready for the workshop.

If all goes according to plan, you should have a Holo Reality Module (mod) ready to upload to Itchio by the end of the workshop for others to download and play. Yay!

[url=https://forms.gle/ue7Jc37igtP8J4uG9]Register here. It's free.[/url]

It's Friday! And this is a special Friday because it's a RELEASE Friday!
That's right! Episode 4 - Part 1 is now live!

Update Edit: [i]It's also a sad day for my family. I lost someone dear to me this morning, someone even dearer to my loved ones, and my heart is aching with them for our loss. I wish things weren't the way they are. I wish I could do more to ease their suffering.[/i]

[b]Project Details:[/b]
167,666 words in total. (That's roughly the same length as the first two Harry Potter novels combined)
825 possible choices.

Patrons can get their version over here [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/98143999](win|mac|lin)[/url] or here [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/98144000](android)[/url], and everyone else can get the full game on Steam or Itchio!

There is a lot of brushing against each other, making Matthias very conscious of your presence which leads to some embarrassment on his behalf. Snippets of Reyna's arc
Snippets of Veera's arc
Some more Raymond stuff

As a team we've also been spending some time exploring the lore and world-building, including how Cephilusks sleep. We've got some really cool ideas, but I'm curious as to how YOU imagine they sleep. notes.title: Devlog 2023-04-07
notes.notes:
Happy Easter Friday to those of you that observe!

I made another week of progress. Everyone seems to be enjoying the new content. I haven't any player created stories yet, so if you do end up creating something, let me know so I can tell everyone else about it!

I've been working on some behind the scenes boring admin stuff, and Trix has been helping me rebuild the entire story controller. If you ever run into her on the streets, please give her a sincere hug and a high-five.

The new story controller is much more robust, and won't break your saves as often as the old one did. That's reason enough, and yet I'm most excited about the additional storytelling capabilities I now have access to.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223954/7815d669ece9c65b50e2e51a702533e9254921f9.png[/img]

I've started creating some fluff scenes for you to run into around the ship. My focus has been on Aeroponics, specifically when Lebeny isn't there. Your Mah'Abeu will be able to snoop around Lebeny's personal plant collection, or maybe they'll do an inspection on what Lebeny has been growing in the aeroponics chambers. Your Mah'Abeu can also choose violence and chaos by overfeeding Lebeny's fish. Down the line, there might be a steam achievement in it for those of you who commit to the cause.

Having 'free roaming' exploration is fantastic, but it also provides a narrative challenge. If players are going from empty room to empty room looking for content, I have failed as a storyteller. From a game design perspective, visiting an empty room should be fun and interesting while giving players the opportunity to learn more about the world. It should also shift and change with each visit while dropping hooks that can trigger scenes that would otherwise be hidden.

Visiting Lebeny's private plant collection should be something players want to do. They should be just as excited to discover what new weird and wonderful plants Lebeny is experimenting with as they would be to actually find Lebeny and talk to her.

I've put a lot of thought into these 'free roaming' events over the last two years, and seeing them become a reality has filled me with renewed excitement and passion to channel into Infinite Stars. Thank you for sharing this journey with me!

I have a busy weekend filled with family time ahead of me and hope all of you get to experience the same joy and peace with your loved ones.

Be kind and stay safe!

James <3

notes.title: Devlog 2023-02-17
notes.notes:
Friday!! Yay! FriDAY! FriDAY!

As always, on the personal side, all has been well. The little one is healthy and growing and it's surreal to think that we'll have a new family member in a couple of months! <3 Power outages are still a thing, and they will continue to be a thing for at least another year if not longer, but life is life, and I'm still privileged enough to have a roof over my head, and a laptop with a battery that generally lasts throughout the outages, which is more than most people can say.

On to the main feature, Infinite Stars!

We've been struggling to get the optimised version of the new expressions working via the code, and as of earlier today, we had a breakthrough! It's working! With the blinking animation! Soon the whole crew will be blinking idly at you while you read their dialogue. It's not a huge thing, but it makes a difference. Just like the mid-sentence expression changes (which are a pain to script, by the way!), it makes the characters feel a little more alive. Special shout-out to Trix who has been amazing during this whole process!

It took way longer to implement than I thought it would, but now that it's in, we can continue scripting!

Lochem's scene is coded, as is the continuation after the cliffhanger, and all the side branches for the different love interests. All that still needs to be done is assigning the actual facial expressions.

The new crew member sprites are in various stages of being implemented, and now that the new expression system is working, they should all be in the game by end of next week. (By the way, I've uploaded some new emoticons of all the new sprites on [url=https://discord.gg/QtAxhP6]our Discord server[/url] if you wanted to steal a sneak peek at the new crew faces!)

I know some of you are reading this and thinking "Cool!" before clicking away, but I'd like to put what we've done into context. When I launched Infinite Stars, we had a total of 6 expressions for each character. Later, we changed that to 9 expressions for each character. [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/devlog-2022-05-66661865]I don't know if you can recall this post from last year[/url], where split the mouth and eyes of each character, allowing us to create 81 different expressions. By splitting the eyes and eyebrows for all the human characters, we've now upped the 81 expressions to 810 different expressions, not including the blush layer. (The characters can blush, which actually makes it 1620 different expressions each, but I feel that's cheating a bit, even if it's technically true. Also, some characters have an additional wink layer, which again ups the 1620 layers to... you get the idea.)

I've included a VERY large reference image of Katya's new expressions for you to browse through all the nuanced emotions she can now display. It's not perfect, and some expressions might still change, but here it is! (Another shout-out, this time to Odikeraz who created these images to help me reference/code the expressions faster!)

[url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/devlog-2023-02-78824802][image][/url]

Lastly, I don't do a call to action like this very often, but if you want to enable me to create even more cool stuff for Infinite Stars and Draegan Herald, [url=https://www.patreon.com/join/infinitestars/signup]please consider becoming a Patron.[/url] I realise $3 or $12 can be a lot of money, depending on where you are in the world, but even a custom recurring pledge of $1 adds up over a few months. I love pushing the boundaries of what Infinite Stars can be, and with your help, the potential is truly infinite!

Have fun, stay safe and enjoy your weekend!

notes.title: Devlog 2022-05-06
notes.notes:
::Excited Friday Noises::

We did it. We're survivors. We made it through another week! And as a reward, you get a devlog update. (It might not be the reward you want or deserve, but it's the reward you are getting.)

My personal life has been OK. I secretly turned a year older last month. Dobson is entering his second winter and hates getting up in the morning. We leave him to sleep in while we start working to pay for all his treats. I've been spending some weekend time with family, and I'm slowly chipping away at my day job responsibilities.

Now, for the reason you actually clicked on this post. Infinite Stars. I took half a day to replay the content from Episode 3 to get a refresher. It sounds silly, but when working on each story segment in isolation, it's easy to miss the forest for the trees. It was great to refresh my view of the game. I also fixed some minor flow issues, added some more flavour choices and fixed some more typos.

I've done lots of writing this week. Lots. I also realised I've grossly misjudged the work it would take to finish the current episode, and that's even before the… You know. Everything that happened. I look back at some of the words I've uttered, like "weekly updates", and I'm almost too ashamed to show my face around here. While I can't wait to wrap up the current episode finally, it's not because I'm getting tired of working on it. I just want to get it done so we can get to all the other juicy bits we've been planning for over a year. Player created stories. Free exploration. Shorter, micro-content releases. I'm super excited about all of that.

Lastly, with all the writing that has been happening, I've also been working on some of the various steamy, kinky and, quite frankly, explicit scenes involving the Tabitha crew. We're all adults here. I hope it will tease and titillate unless you are a minor. Then it just teases and fades to black. (Should you really be playing games with adult content as a minor?) I can't enforce it, but I can prevent minors and those of us who are more gentle in nature from running into sudden sexy surprise smut. I've given the solution a lot of thought, and explicit content will be turned off by default and will have to be turned on in the settings. While there is definitely some character insight and development during the smut scenes, it's also written in such a way that skipping it won't leave you confused or missing any major plot points. Players who are unaware of the setting will be able to go through the whole game with a few fade to black scenes without even knowing they missed anything.

Lastly, our Discord server has been growing slowly. If you'd like to be more involved in shaping the game, come join us! Right now, we're asking for everyone to share a scene from the game that annoyed them, felt boring or just made your eyes roll so we can fix it for the Steam release. Also, once we reach 500 members, we can apply to become an actual community server - we're still a way off but getting there. So come join the server, say hi, and meet more Infinite Star fans. (As a bonus, you'll get to see some photos of Dobby the House Iggy and other pets owned by fans.) What are you waiting for?
